name: Glacies no Namida
source:
That day, Clarice died.
Her faithful soul was supposed to go to heaven.
But, she had a regret.
"God... even devil! Please let me meet that person once more!"
After that, her soul wanders and arrives at a mysterious woman.
"Okay, I'll grant your wish. However, there are two conditions. If you don't follow them, you will become water and dissolve."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/9588]official site[/url]]
translation:
那天，克拉丽丝去世了。
她忠实的灵魂应该去天堂。
但是，她却有一个遗憾。
“上帝……甚至是魔鬼！请让我再次见到那个人吧！”
之后，她的灵魂徘徊，来到了一位神秘女子的身边。
“好吧，我就满足你的愿望，不过，有两个条件，如果不遵守的话，你就会化为水，溶解。”

[翻译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/9588]官方网站[/url]]
